notes.title: Pill Fight is OUT!
notes.content: [p]I am really happy that Pill Fight ha finally released! a gameplay trailer will be up soon on my youtube channel, but i hope you enjoy a game about shooting what is in effect, capsules with wacky faces.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Announcing the map Editor
notes.content:
[p]Quite literally what it says! Pill Fight will be coming with a map editor, allowing you to share and play other people's maps, in just a few clicks, the game will feature a section for installed maps, which includes your published maps which remain installed on your system, and a section for workshop maps, where to play the maps all you have to do is click on them to install, and the game will automatically load them once its done![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]here you can see the current look of this menu, indeed it does need to be improved[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465534/683a106ff1ca1e1c800944ac157eafc9e1266c34.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]tutorials for how to use the Editor will become available on this channel soon:


[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@SmartCat-p3h"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Still around and happy for the results of Next Fest
notes.content: [p]Even if just seven of you played the game, it's a start and considering my marketing budget is 0% its good to see![/p][p][/p][p]So what are some news to share? well i've added in a new enemy type, similar to the archer you've seen in the demo but meant to keep you moving, i'm also working on something to keep the game's life  going for quite a while! i'm not ready to talk about it as it's something that i've never worked on so i don't have experience with, hopefully i'll be able to talk about it soon...[/p][p][/p][p]Thats all for now![/p]

notes.title: What is Pill Fight?
notes.content:
The game is really it's most simplest concept, waves of enemies come and attack you,  you need to destroy them and survive as long as you can! Over time the spawn rates will decrease, thus, increasing the number of enemies on screen and new enemy types will appear that need diferent ways to eliminate them.

Like with my previous game, "The Overground" which you can check out here:


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383380/The_Overground/



This game has 2 SEPERATE versions available for free on itch.io, but this one is infinitely better, due to ONE simple mechanic, well two.

First, in the free versions, enemies just disappear, while in this one, they break apart! which you can see in the video in the store page, and it makes things just so much fun.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465534/880057502aaa1437b1bc939993f7f4d995321f9d.png[/img], 




and the fact that there will be an upgrade screen where you can choose between a myriad of both ACTIVE and PASSIVE skills! well that's all for now, remember to wihlist Pill Fight and try out the demo, where you can play one of the maps and try all the default skills you start with.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469010/Pill_Fight/
